recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片細胞豐富，可見顆粒球系從骨髓球、後骨髓球、帶狀核到分葉核的完整成熟序列，夾雜核深染圓形的紅血球前驅細胞，無芽細胞增加或單一細胞族群佔優勢，屬正常三系造血的成人骨髓。
features: Cellular aspirate smear with orderly granulocytic maturation from myelocytes to segmented neutrophils
Erythroid precursors with round dense nuclei and polychromatic cytoplasm interspersed
Granulocytic predominance with an apparently normal myeloid-to-erythroid ratio
No increase in blasts, no dysplastic forms, and no abnormal infiltrate
Scattered fat vacuoles; no megakaryocyte in this field
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular spread with mixed hematopoietic elements. Granulocytic precursors show orderly maturation through myelocyte, metamyelocyte, band, and segmented stages, with interspersed erythroid precursors displaying normal maturation. Blasts are not increased, no dysplasia is evident, and no abnormal cell population is identified; megakaryocytes are not present in this field and should be assessed at low power. Findings are consistent with normal adult bone marrow with trilineage hematopoiesis.

ddx.vs: Shows increased myeloid-to-erythroid ratio with toxic granulation and left shift, which are not evident here.
Shows marked granulocytic hyperplasia with myelocyte bulge, basophilia, and small hypolobated megakaryocytes.
Requires dysplasia such as hypogranular or pseudo-Pelger neutrophils and megaloblastoid or ringed erythroid precursors, none seen here.
